column3: Gah. Did I step on a landmine?!
If you really want to accompany me that much, I guess it can't be helped!
Oh, please let me accompany you!
It can't be helped?! Who would say such a thing!
Haven't I heard that line before?
Your spirit and participation are important for doing this!
What's with that expression? Do I need to take out my phone again?
You know, I'm still your elder brother...
Yes, yes, I got it, I got it.
It doesn't look like she's got it, though...
